pending_diagnosis: DIAGNOSIS: Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis (associated with an Ovarian Teratoma) THE SMOKING GUN: The progression from acute psychiatric symptoms to orofacial dyskinesias, autonomic crisis, and the pathognomonic Extreme Delta Brush on EEG in a young female. PATHOPHYSIOLOGY: IgG antibodies form against the GluN1 subunit of the NMDA (N-methyl-D-aspartate) glutamate receptors, frequently triggered by ectopic neural tissue embedded within an occult mature ovarian teratoma. Antibody binding causes cross-linking, capping, and internalization of the surface NMDA receptors. The resulting depletion of NMDA receptors selectively disrupts inhibitory GABAergic interneuron circuits, leading to massive disinhibition of dopaminergic and autonomic signaling pathways, precipitating severe neuropsychiatric collapse, movement disorders, autonomic instability, and loss of respiratory drive.
